full_prompt_en: A square old-master-style painted portrait shows a gray-bearded man in a glossy deep red garment seated beside a drawing board in a dark interior. His head and shoulders dominate the selected panel. He turns partly toward the viewer, looking outward with raised brows and a composed, slightly questioning expression. Short brown hair recedes at the temples; a thick curled mustache flows into a full gray beard that covers the lower face and neck. A white collar folds up behind the head, separating dark hair from the wine-colored clothing. The long sleeve at right catches many sharp cream and rose highlights along its deep gathered folds, while the chest shows small gold fastenings. At lower left, the visible hand holds a thin drawing implement angled down toward a pale surface just beyond the crop. Behind that hand, a large upright board or open book displays faint geometric lines and colored marks, though none are legible as words. A tall dark vessel or decorative object rises in the upper-left shadow, and the edge of a framed panel appears at upper right. Most of the background remains brown-black, allowing the face, beard, and satin sleeve to emerge. Warm directional light from upper left illuminates forehead, cheek, and reflective cloth, while deep shadows gather under the beard and within the sleeve folds. The viewpoint is close and level, emphasizing both the sitter's gaze and the nearby work surface. The overall composition balances a luminous face with the textured red garment against a quiet dark studio setting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典大师风格肖像画呈现一名灰胡子男子，穿着有光泽的深红衣服，坐在昏暗室内的绘图板旁。头和肩占据所选单图大部分。他部分转向观者，抬眉望出画面，表情沉稳、略带疑问。短棕发在太阳穴处后退，浓密而卷曲的八字胡接到覆盖下脸和颈部的灰胡须。白色衣领在头后翻起，把深发与酒红衣物分开。右侧长袖在深褶上接住许多锐利的乳白与玫瑰色高光，胸前有细小金色扣饰。左下可见的手握着细绘画工具，斜向画框外的浅色表面。手后方，一块直立的大板或翻开的书显示淡淡几何线和色彩记号，但看不出可读文字。高高的深色器皿或装饰物从左上阴影里升起，右上有一幅画框的边缘。背景大部分保持棕黑，让脸、胡须和缎面袖子浮现。左上暖色定向光照亮额头、脸颊和反光布料，深影聚在胡须下及袖褶内部。视点贴近且平齐，同时突出人物目光和旁边的工作表面。整体构图以发亮的脸平衡有肌理的红衣，对照安静昏暗的工作室环境。
style_prompt_en: Old-master-style oil painting uses warm directional chiaroscuro, smooth facial modeling, and richly folded reflective fabric. Deep umber and near-black recesses surround warm flesh, silver-gray, wine red, and small gold accents. Highlights collect on raised satin-like ridges and pale facial planes, while beard texture is rendered with many fine soft strands. Dark objects in the background are selectively suggested rather than fully delineated, keeping the focal mass forward. The composition is a close three-quarter arrangement with a small diagonal tool-like line leading from the lower edge. Surface transitions range from blended skin to visible brush marks in cloth and hair. The overall effect is stately, intimate, and materially sumptuous.
style_prompt_zh: 古典大师风格油画使用暖色定向明暗、平滑面部塑形和褶皱丰富的反光布料。深棕与近黑凹处围住暖肤色、银灰、酒红及少量金色重音。高光聚在抬起的缎面状褶脊和浅色脸部平面，胡须肌理由许多细软发丝表现。背景深色物件被选择性暗示，而非全部描清，使焦点大形体向前突出。构图是贴近的四分之三布局，一道细小工具状斜线从下缘引入。表面过渡从晕染皮肤变化到衣料和发中的可见笔痕。整体效果庄重、亲密，并有丰厚材质感。
theme_en: A gray-bearded man in a red satin garment beside a drawing board
theme_zh: 一名灰胡子男子身穿红色缎衣，坐在绘图板旁
name: Giorgio Vasari
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
